changeSet.sql: UPDATE shipment_rd rd SET origin_department_id = first_delivery.origin_department_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, origin_department_id FROM delivery WHERE target_type = 'SHIPMENT' AND delivery_type = 'OUTBOUND' ORDER BY target_id, created) first_delivery WHERE CAST(rd.shipment_id AS VARCHAR(255)) = first_delivery.target_id

UPDATE shipment_rd rd SET destination_department_id = current_delivery.destination_department_id, planned_delivery_at = current_delivery.planned_delivery_at, delivered_at = current_delivery.delivered_at FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, destination_department_id, planned_delivery_at, delivered_at FROM delivery WHERE target_type = 'SHIPMENT' AND delivery_type = 'OUTBOUND' AND status <> 'CANCELED' ORDER BY target_id, created DESC) current_delivery WHERE CAST(rd.shipment_id AS VARCHAR(255)) = current_delivery.target_id
